explanation: The nonce check in verify must remain: rejecting a previously seen nonce prevents a token from being replayed. #123 is the related issue.
Call ensure_key_salt before constructing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must stop instead of initializing the manager.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, keep topN at or below maxSimpleTopN so the resulting slice stays at or below 1 MiB. maxSimpleTopN is the named limit.
When meta.abi_version is absent, abi must be None. Treating it as the current ABI could misinterpret the metadata. #1784 is the related issue; Abi::from converts a present version.
TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so values there override the drop-in written at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf.

These TLP settings require version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV are profile suffixes. Leave the _AC version of this setting unset so GNOME's Performance toggle continues to work; this command sets only the _BAT version.
On a JsonException, this catch block returns null. The caller is responsible for logging the warning, so this block does not log it.
When an AllowedTools set is in use, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag bypasses the --allowedTools restriction.

For the dead-code decision made by thunk_is_dead, consult the verdict table at rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs in is_definitely_dead_code. The path identifies the file and the text after the colon identifies the symbol.
repos_skipped is a placeholder. Derive its value from the domains-to-repos mapping; #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query uses a linear-time DFA for this regex search, so the query does not incur regex backtracking. regex_query is the referenced method.

Keep this token-family table schema in sync with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. The path identifies the file and the text after the colon identifies the class and method.
MAX_BATCH is 500 because the vendor batch API accepts no more than 500 items per request. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.

Keep these Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Reordering the iota entries changes their stored integer values and can make existing values mean a different status. #88 is the related issue.
Keep this index's columns ordered tenant_id, then created_at, to match the orders_by_tenant query. orders_by_tenant names the query this index supports.
TList.Add relies on FCount never exceeding Length(FItems). Grow must preserve that bound when expanding storage; FCount and FItems are the referenced fields, and Grow is the referenced operation.
close must call _flush before closing _sink because closing drops _buf. Reversing the calls could lose buffered data. _flush, _sink and _buf identify the affected method and fields.

For a path supplied by a request, resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject any .. escape outside that root. This requirement applies to the target path built from userPath; normalization alone does not show the required rejection.
Drain ring before freeing buf. Otherwise an IRQ handler could still use the freed buffer, causing a use-after-free. ring_drain is the required drain operation; #2201 is the related issue.

Reserve space for n items up front so ingestion needs one allocation. Repeated push_back growth previously took 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE into dbo.Accounts because concurrent upserts can race without it. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the referenced documentation.
The autonomous transaction lets an audit row persist even if the calling transaction rolls back. The comment explains the PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION declaration.

SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the needed constraints directly, so this migration creates leases_new as part of rebuilding the table. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant ALTER TABLE documentation section.
The loop polls every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this work would need. The 5 in done.wait(5) is that interval.
Keep the for...of loop when awaiting run(job). An await inside forEach would let errors escape the intended try/catch. forEach and for...of are the loop forms being compared.
A frame returned by read_frame must have length at most MAX_FRAME; the decoder rejects larger frames. Vec<u8> is the frame's type, and MAX_FRAME is the named size limit.
Register drainHook with addShutdownHook before calling pool.start(). The hook drains the pool on SIGTERM, so it must be installed before the pool starts.

Move backoff's fixed retry delay into configuration. The task is complete when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path identifies the file and Default the symbol. The current delay is two seconds.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among the LeaseState values Active, Released and Stale.
Pass the token to tool login through standard input only. Putting it in command arguments would expose it through ps, which shows argv to other users. --token-stdin selects the standard-input path.
Create the app_reader role before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists; app_reader is the role named by both statements.
Make on_event idempotent because Stripe can retry a webhook for three days, so the same event may arrive more than once. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook retry documentation.
Compare sig and expected with hmac.Equal. It performs a constant-time MAC comparison; using == would expose timing information.
Build the CodeGraph from facts once per index. The build costs O(edges), so doing it for every query would repeat that work. CodeGraph::build is the referenced constructor.
Changing the packed layout of TCustomerRec can make existing saved .dat files unreadable or misread. Bump FILE_VERSION when changing that layout; FILE_VERSION is the referenced version marker.
Change MSG_MAX together with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h so the limits stay consistent. The path identifies the header and the text after the colon identifies its constant.
After authMiddleware runs, session.userId must be non-null. The handler relies on that authentication invariant; authMiddleware is the referenced middleware.
Keep the check and subsequent put under synchronized(cache) so they happen atomically. Using ConcurrentHashMap alone would not make that two-step operation atomic.
Validate the user-supplied repository alias against the registry before joining it into a path. This prevents an unvalidated alias from affecting path construction. #1996 is the related issue.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative. Represent refunds as separate rows with Kind = 'R', rather than as negative Amount values. Amount and Kind are the referenced columns.
Set stop_ before calling worker_.join(). Otherwise the worker may never stop and join can block forever; stop_ is the stop flag and worker_ is the thread being joined.

The limiter is sized around the GitHub API limit of 5,000 requests per hour per token. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the rate-limit documentation; the 720 millisecond interval corresponds to that hourly rate.
Stop the cidx service before replacing /usr/local/bin/cidx. Replacing the binary while it is running can fail with “Text file busy.”
Do not share _lease between jobs: a shared CredentialLease could expose one user's credentials to another. #77 is the related issue. This field declaration is where that sharing risk needs attention.

Keep len(ids) at or below 999 when building this DELETE statement, because its bound parameters must fit the stated SQLite per-statement variable limit. ids supplies the values for the placeholders in marks.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails, warn and let the job continue. The comment says containment setup can fail because of a bad memory estimate and should not abort the job.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route registered here. #530 tracks its removal.

The session model decision is documented at doc:adr-007#session-model. It explains why SessionRegistry keeps sessions per tab; adr-007 is the referenced decision document and session-model its anchor.
This partial index speeds up active-lease lookups by about 30 times. Its WHERE released_at IS NULL clause indexes only unreleased leases, keyed by credential_id.
Keep EVENT_TYPES in sync with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. The first path identifies a code symbol; the second identifies the event documentation.
